title: observability: token-kv metrics & logging - dashboard + alert tuning enhancements
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: Token-level KV cache telemetry and disk-logging for cold starts were incomplete for some model variants (especially quantized/low-memory runners). This made it hard to correlate user-facing latency spikes with KV cache behavior or cold-start flakiness.

What this PR does: Adds new metrics, logging, dashboard panels, and tuned alerts focused on token-level KV cache behavior and token-level cost/latency breakdowns. Changes are implemented to be low-overhead in steady state (metrics aggregated at shard/runner granularity with sampling for verbatim request payload logging). Dashboard panels added to the Observability Console and alert thresholds adjusted to reduce noisy alerts while preserving SLO coverage.

Summary of changes (high-level):
- New metrics: kv_cache.token_hits, kv_cache.token_misses, kv_cache.evictions, kv_cache.prefetch_latency_ms, token.cost_usd_per_thousand_tokens (model-tagged)
- Logging: structured cold-start logs written to disk with contextual runner/model metadata (sampled 1/100 requests) + safe redaction of user PII
- Dashboards: new panels for token-level hit/miss rates, per-runner cost breakdown, and KV prefetch latency histograms; added links from trace spans to relevant dashboard panels
- Alerts: tuned SRE alerts to trigger only when sustained token-miss rate > 5% for > 10m on production pools or when prefetch latency p95 > 500ms for 5m
- Rollout: feature-flagged metrics/logging, phased enablement via rollout config (10% -> 50% -> 100%); migration scripts for existing dashboards

Checklist:
- [x] Add metrics and safe logging implementation
- [x] Dashboard JSON and migrations
- [x] Alert rules and runbook updates
- [x] Unit & integration tests for metrics emission and redaction
- [x] Load test on perf-canary (10k requests/s snapshot)

Testing and results:
- Ran perf-canary workload against dedicated pool; observed KV token-hit improvement visibility and no measurable CPU overhead at 50% sampling; disk logging sampling kept under 2MB/min per node in tested workload.
- CI: initial lint failure fixed (see commit history), full test suite passed, e2e observability smoke tests passed on staging.

Rollout notes: Enable feature flag for non-prod pools immediately. Gradual enablement for production pools with SRE monitoring the new alerts for 48h at each stage. If noisy, revert via feature flag (runbook included).
